scripts.build: echo '[1/2] Building client...' && npm run build:client && echo '[2/2] Building server...' && npm run build:server && echo 'Build complete!'
scripts.build:client: cd client && echo 'Installing client deps...' && npm install && echo 'Compiling client...' && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && echo 'Installing server deps...' && npm install && echo 'Compiling server...' && npm run build
